name: The wider area of Mount Olympus
description: Mount Olympus rises near the Aegean coast of northern Greece, and at 2,917 metres its jagged summit, Mytikas, is the country's highest point. Ancient Greeks imagined Zeus and the Twelve Olympian Gods living among its peaks. Today hikers set out from the town of Litochoro to climb past gorges, limestone cliffs and glacier-carved bowls, through forests rich in rare plants.
